name: Checklist
label: Checklist
description: Tasks with a done state each, an owner and an action, under a count done and a progress bar.

props.name: items
props.description: The tasks, in the order they are best done.

props.name: title
props.description:
The checklist's heading, which names its section.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which Checklist does not expose.

props.name: values
props.description: The ids of the done tasks, for a controlled list. Leave undefined to let the list keep its own, seeded from `defaultValues`.

props.name: defaultValues
props.description: The ids done on first render when the list is uncontrolled.

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description: Fires with every done id after a task is ticked or unticked.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the done marks without letting them change, for a list that reports what the host already knows (a setup's steps, a review's checks).

props.name: showProgress
props.description: Shows how many tasks are done, as a count and a bar, under the heading. Defaults to true.

props.name: progressLabel
props.description: The progress count, given the done and total tasks already written in the resolved locale. Defaults to "3 of 5 done".

props.name: ownerLabel
props.description: The owner avatar's accessible name, given the owner's name. Defaults to "Owner: <name>".

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: A read-only row's state, read after its label. Defaults to "Done".

props.name: notDoneLabel
props.description: A read-only row's state when it is not done. Defaults to "Not done".

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the counts are written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: size
props.description: Row density: `compact` for a checklist in a side panel.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The title's place in the outline. Defaults to 3, a part of a section.

rows.text: Ticks the box, or clears it when it is ticked.

alternatives.name: AgentPlan
alternatives.when: the list is an agent’s plan that it works through itself, with live step states
